plugins.name: mic-frequency-response
plugins.description: Digitize microphone frequency-response charts into a queryable CSV database — a zero-dependency web Digitizer (semi-automatic pixel tracing) plus an AI-visual-reading skill for real gridded manufacturer charts. Covers frequency-response AND polar-pattern charts. Ships example data (Shure SM58, Audio-Technica AT2020: FR + 6/4 polar frequencies each).
